Read a ride file

Source: R/read_file.R
read_file.Rd

Reads a .fit, .gpx or .csv file into the canonical ride schema, so nothing downstream has to care which format a ride arrived in.

Usage

read_file(path)

Arguments

path

Path or URL of a .fit, .gpx or .csv file. A CSV needs a time column, in ISO 8601 or epoch seconds, and a power column.

Value

A tibble with time (POSIXct, UTC) and power (watts), plus whichever of cadence, heart_rate, speed, distance, altitude, temperature, lat and lon the file carries, ordered by time.

See also

Other reading: read_rides(), ride_spec_from_names()

Examples

read_file(system.file("extdata", "power_strava.gpx", package = "cyclingpower"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 8
#>   time                power cadence heart_rate altitude temperature   lat    lon
#>   <dttm>              <dbl>   <dbl>      <dbl>    <dbl>       <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 2024-03-01 09:00:00   210      88        132     12.4          18  51.5 -0.125
#> 2 2024-03-01 09:00:01   224      89        133     12.6          18  51.5 -0.125
#> 3 2024-03-01 09:00:02   197      87        134     12.9          18  51.5 -0.125

# FIT needs FITfileR, which is not on CRAN
read_file(system.file("extdata", "power1.fit", package = "cyclingpower"))
#> # A tibble: 3,601 × 6
